page.overview:
Who is Marshal?

Marshal is the fourth member of Unova's Elite Four who specializes in using -type Pokémon.

Marshal is a young, muscular man, with orange-accented short hair and eyebrows. He wears a sleeveless teal jacket, teal bands around his biceps, orange fingerless gloves, a black belt around his waist, as well as orange trackpants with teal outlines. He does not wear shoes.

Possessing a very Choleric oriented nature, Marshal is formidable in his training and various stances. Not a type for comedy, Marshal is extremely strict to both himself and the Pokémon he trains. A common trait for Trainers of his type, Marshal has a bulky and disciplined figure similar to that of a professional athlete.

Being a Fighting-type expert, Marshal's name comes from "martial arts".
